title: Eye structure and amphibious foraging in albatrosses
journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B 265(1397): 665-671
why: Only the abstract was open. The full text would give the binocular maximum width (26 to 32 deg) and the retinal field values for the black-browed albatross separately from the grey-headed, which would turn the pooled genus value into a species measurement (m).
